implementation_disposition.closure_boundary: The implementation closeout is archived; ongoing effectiveness is evaluated longitudinally instead of treated as present-tense implementation proof.

evaluation_disposition.closure_authority: implementation issue may close because only longitudinal effectiveness evidence remains; later negative conclusions reopen or create bounded work

future_evidence_audit.scope: Open repository issues were inspected for implementation closure blocked only by future, longitudinal, or repeated-session evidence.
future_evidence_audit.other_issue_disposition: No other open issue was found whose sole remaining acceptance gate was future evidence; issues with present-tense implementation gaps remain open under their existing owners.
future_evidence_audit.classification_rule: Present implementation proof remains in closeout records; recurring or delayed effectiveness evidence is collected through the Evaluation lifecycle and later negative findings create or reopen bounded work.
